# Fixture data license

The archives in this folder are 10-second cuts of GrandTour mission 2024-11-04-10-57-34
(topics prism_position, cpt7_ie_tc_odometry, dlio_map_odometry, anymal_state_odometry, tf),
made with `scripts/make_fixture.py`. Only timestamps, sequence ids, positions and orientations are kept.

Source: The GrandTour Dataset, Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich, https://grand-tour.leggedrobotics.com/
(Hugging Face: leggedrobotics/grand_tour_dataset).
